title: Hruday window-kernel certificate for the centered Wilson correlation at the original cap
selection_reason: The Poisson kernel's absolute first moment diverges and forces the 1.2651e-6 floor at s=1, tau=10^-8. A C^2 window equal to e^{-sx} on the nonnegative spectral support has an L^1 transform with finite first moment, removing the cutoff and its tail. Combined with the AV1 linear state bound it targets the original cap and the unchanged 10^-6 point-error target.
model: Same actual chosen centered-box subsequential AQ state as AT4 at tau=+10^-8 (and -10^-8 as a control), selected triple (0,0,0), original xz Wilson, physical clock s=alpha*t_E/hbar, s=1, complete cover R={0,e_z} with seven incident stars, Haar product reference C_0(s)=e^{-3s}/4. The AV1 state bound D is the state premise.

parameters.window: g(x)=e^{-sx} for x>=0; g(x)=e^{sx}(1-2sx+2s^2x^2) for x<0
parameters.window_transform: ghat(theta)=4s^3/(pi(s-i theta)^3(s+i theta)), |ghat|=(4s^3/pi)(s^2+theta^2)^-2, ||ghat||_1=2, int|theta||ghat|=4s/pi, int theta^2|ghat|=2s^2
parameters.duhamel_slope: k=49|tau|/4 in G=H/alpha units from ||B_N||<=49|tau|/8 (seven stars)
parameters.state_bound: D from research/round32/advisor/av1-gate.json (tier ii if admitted, else tier i)
retained_insufficient_controls: optimized Poisson floor ~1.2651e-6 at L~4.08e6 with D->0

required: 1. Window lemma. Freeze the conventions c(theta)=<chi,e^{i theta G}chi> and ghat(theta)=(2pi)^-1 int g(x)e^{-i theta x}dx. Prove g in L^1 cap C_0, ghat in L^1, pointwise inversion on the nonnegative spectral support using AQ1 nonnegativity only (not the AQ2 gap), and Fubini with the finite centered spectral measure. Conclude C(s)=int ghat(theta)c(theta)dtheta and C_0(s)=g(3)/4=e^{-3s}/4.

2. Constants. Prove ghat(theta)=4s^3/(pi(s-i theta)^3(s+i theta)), |ghat|=(4s^3/pi)(s^2+theta^2)^-2, M_0=||ghat||_1=2, M_1=int|theta||ghat|=4s/pi and M_2=int theta^2|ghat|=2s^2. Forward: half-line transforms. Reverse: residues. The reverse checker computes these values from its own derivation and compares them with the contract; pi is enclosed with directed rounding.

3. Real-time comparison. Prove |c(theta)-c_0(theta)|<=k|theta|+D+m^2 for all real theta with the admitted seven-star relative-unitary Duhamel argument (AT4 F10-F12), k=49|tau|/4 in G=H/alpha units, D the AV1-admitted tier value, m^2<=D^2; the D/2 effect refinement is not applied to W alpha^0_theta(W).

4. Radius. E=M_0(D+D^2)+k M_1 at tau=+10^-8 and -10^-8, s=1, itemized as state, mean-square, kernel-dynamics and arithmetic terms, with a directed enclosure of e^{-3}/4 as the exact rational datum, and a Boolean against the unchanged 10^-6.

5. Retained failures. Keep the AT4 L=10^4 Poisson radius and the optimized Poisson floor 1.2651e-6 at unchanged tau and s, and exhibit the divergent Poisson first moment against the window's finite one.
6. Crossover. Report the s* where E=10^-6 (about 6.1-6.3); no grid claim beyond it and no [0,128] claim at the cap.
7. No resolved shift. e^{-3}/4 lies inside the interval; the result carries the sub-label reference_unresolved.

8. Calculator. An AT5-style exact calculator (exact inputs only; floats rejected; fixed_design mode) restricted to the proved domain: zero selected triple, |tau|<=10^-8, s>0, positive physical scales, D from the admitted AV1 tier only (control av1_tier_bound).

9. Freeze protocol with research/round32/tools/freeze.py; byte-identical normal and -O replays; claim flags continuum_claim:false, uniform_wilson_claim:false, resolved_interaction_shift:false, scientific_priority_verified:false, euclidean_node_certified:<bool>, grid_claim:false.

10. The -tau radius comes from the same formula and is reported as a replay of the certificate at the mirrored coupling, not as a second confirmation; the C^1 window is registered as a preview-only control.
claim_exclusions: AQ uniqueness or a rate in N

acceptance.accepted_within_scope: Lemma and constants proved by both routes; E<=10^-6 at tau=+10^-8, s=1 with the admitted tier-(ii) D (preview 1.7-2.0e-7); both signs; insufficient controls retained.
acceptance.limited: Only tier (i) is admitted (preview 3.6-4.7e-5), or only one route's constants survive.
acceptance.insufficient: The lemma or the constants fail; the Poisson floor stands.

stop: Investigation 2 of 10; sub-round 1 ends after its review and the assistants' tests.
premise_note: The window g and its transform are frozen in this contract as a shared panel premise. The forward producer proves the constants by half-line transforms; the reverse producer by residues (simple pole at theta=is, triple pole at theta=-is) and must not read the skeptic's derivation files listed in forward_additional_premises before both freezes.
